bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Saint Stefan Romanian Orthodox Church.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SAINT STEFAN ROMANIAN ORTHODOX CHURCH.

$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to St. Stefan Romanian Orthodox Church in South St. Paul to repair and preserve the cultural and historic landmark for the Romanian community.
